teaching_objective: After this lesson, the learner can explain what HTML is and why it is used to structure web pages.
teaching_approach: Use the analogy of a house blueprint: HTML provides the structure and layout of a web page, just like a blueprint defines the rooms and walls of a house. Emphasize that HTML is not programming but a markup language — it's about describing content, not logic.
key_points: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language for creating web pages.
HTML is a markup language, not a programming language — it uses tags to describe content.
This course will teach you how to read and write HTML so you can build your own web pages.
context_so_far: This is the first lesson. The learner has no prior context from this course.
